bug_analysis.issue_description: Confidence score percentage display discrepancy between different UI components
reported_symptoms: Smart Translation screen shows '200% confidence' but AI Clarification Assistant shows '0.2%' (should be 20%)
When goal is improved to 'lose 30 pounds and run 30 KM/week', it shows '90%' on one screen but '0.9%' in chat (should be 90%)
Clarification questions still ask for specifics even after user provides them

backend_confidence_format.finding: Backend correctly stores and returns confidence as decimal values (0-1 range)
evidence: smart-goal-processor.ts lines 481-487: Normalizes confidence values to 0-1 range, converting percentages if needed
goals.ts routes return confidence directly from processor results
All instances correctly multiply by 100 to convert decimal to percentage
Lines 81, 105, 129, 153, 177: All SMART criteria correctly multiply by 100
Lines 188, 215: Also correctly convert to percentage

api_layer.finding: API layer (api.ts) passes confidence values through without modification
api_layer.evidence: No manipulation of confidence scores found in api.ts
